C1192.title: Misconfigured Kubernetes Cluster Networking and Lateral Movement Risks
C1192.summary: A study of 287 open source applications identified 634 network misconfigurations in Kubernetes clusters that could be exploited for lateral movement attacks. The misconfigurations involve service exposure and missing network policies, enabling attackers to pivot within the cluster.

references.title: Defending Kubernetes Clusters Against Network Misconfigurations
